payload.reason: The evidence indicates that multiple baselines were tested, including a majority-class baseline and other specific baselines for answerability identification.

claims.text: Three baselines were described for the answerability task, which improved performance over a majority-class baseline.
The best performing BERT variant was compared against the NA model and human performance.
BERT exhibited the best performance on a binary answerability identification task, indicating it was one of the tested baselines.
